title: Estimating Grammatical Gender Directions in Contextual Embeddings under Controlled and Natural Contexts

bias_targets.methodology: A WEAT-style cosine similarity scoring framework to quantify semantic gender contamination in inanimate nouns, and projection-based evaluation metrics (Inanimate Noun Reduction Score and Occupational Preservation Score) to measure the disentanglement of grammatical gender leakage from social semantic gender stereotypes.
